narrative: I was charged an annual fee on my card after I had already called to close the account and the representative confirmed the closure.
There is an account on my credit report that does not belong to me. I filed a dispute with the bureau two months ago and nothing has changed.
A collection agency keeps calling me six times a day at work demanding payment for a debt I already settled in full.
My mortgage servicer changed without notice and my escrow payment jumped by four hundred dollars with no breakdown provided.
My checking account was overdrawn and the bank charged four separate overdraft fees in one day by reordering transactions.
The bank placed a hold on my payroll deposit for three days without explaining why, and I could not pay rent on time.
My credit card limit was reduced without warning which pushed my utilisation up and hurt my score.
